ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms environments, intentional differences and the unrecorded-difference flag are declared; it does not compare deployed resources.
offer: Compare environments against their intentional differences and keep unexplained drift visible. Identical filenames are not evidence that deployed settings or resources agree.

minimal.reason: List the environments compared. An unnamed environment is outside the check, so enumerate dev, staging and production as applicable.

mid.reason: Record the differences that are intentional. Unexplained differences are drift, so document each deliberate one.

maximal.reason: Set unrecorded differences allowed to false. A hidden difference makes staging results meaningless, so record or remove it.
